short_description: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: four things GTA 5 gave you that GTA 6 took away. 1) Mission replay: GTA 6 has no replay menu (GTAboom, Insider Gaming). 2) A full first-person mode: not at launch, Rockstar says; it only switches when you aim (TweakTown, Insider Gaming). 3) Carrying every gun: GTA 6 limits what you carry and keeps the rest in your vehicle (Rockstar's Rob Nelson, via GTABase). 4) Safe cash: in GTA 5 dying cost a small hospital bill; in GTA 6, Rockstar says the cash you carry disappears if you die before depositing it (TweakTown, GTA Intel). Footage: official Rockstar gameplay. Which one hurts most?

short_es.title: GTA 6 te quitó 4 cosas que GTA 5 te daba #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: cuatro cosas que GTA 6 quitó. 1) Repetir misiones. 2) Modo primera persona completo (no al lanzamiento, según Rockstar). 3) Llevar todas las armas: ahora llevas pocas y el resto queda en tu coche. 4) Dinero seguro: en GTA 6 el efectivo que llevas desaparece si mueres sin depositarlo.

short.headline: GTA 6 TOOK THESE AWAY
short.text: GTA 6 took away four things GTA 5 gave you.
short.text_es: GTA 6 te quitó cuatro cosas que GTA 5 te daba.

short.headline: 1. MISSION REPLAY: GONE
short.text: One. Mission replay. GTA 5 let you replay any mission. GTA 6 has no replay menu.
short.text_es: Uno. Repetir misiones. GTA 5 te dejaba repetir cualquier misión. GTA 6 no tiene ese menú.

short.headline: 2. FIRST PERSON: GONE
short.text: Two. First person. In GTA 5 you could play the whole game that way. GTA 6 only switches when you aim, at least at launch.
short.text_es: Dos. Primera persona. En GTA 5 podías jugar todo así. GTA 6 solo cambia al apuntar, al menos al lanzamiento.

short.headline: 3. EVERY GUN ON YOU: GONE
short.text: Three. Your whole arsenal. GTA 6 lets you carry just a few guns. The rest stay in your car.
short.text_es: Tres. Tu arsenal. En GTA 6 llevas pocas armas. El resto se queda en tu coche.

short.headline: 4. SAFE CASH: GONE
short.text: Four. Safe cash. Dying in GTA 5 cost a small hospital bill. In GTA 6, Rockstar says the cash you carry disappears.
short.text_es: Cuatro. Dinero seguro. Morir en GTA 5 costaba poco. En GTA 6, Rockstar dice que el efectivo que llevas desaparece.

short.headline: WHICH HURTS MOST?
short.text: Which one hurts most? Reply one to four, because
short.text_es: ¿Cuál duele más? Responde del uno al cuatro, porque
